 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bayern Munich will look to return to winning ways in the Bundesliga when they travel to Mainz 05, with the league leaders facing a side desperate to end their recent slump.
 The Bavarians have had to deal with a lot of injuries in recent weeks and don't have the best record playing in Mainz in the Bundesliga recently (just 2 wins in the last 6 games) - can the hosts surprise the Rekordmeister once more?
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With just about an hour to go until kickoff, both head coaches have officially announced their lineups - you can see them if full detail below.
 Confirmed Mainz 05 vs. FC Bayern lineups:
 Mainz 05 (3-5-2): 
 Zentner - Da Costa, Gruber, Potulski - Caci, Lee, Sano, Amiri, Widmer - Königsdörffer, Becker
 FC Bayern (4-2-3-1): 
 Neuer - Laimer, Upamecano, Tah, Stanišić - Kimmich, Pavlović - Olise, Karl, Brown - Kane
